svg.style: background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.text: PEMROSESAN PARALEL & TERDISTRIBUSI: BATCH vs STREAMING
BATCH (Apache Spark / MapReduce): Throughput tinggi • Latensi menit–jam • ETL periodik • Training ML
File batch harian → Spark Cluster → Partisi RDD/DataFrame (In-Memory komputasi iteratif)
STREAM (Kafka + Apache Flink): Latensi sub-detik • Deteksi fraud seketika • Monitoring IoT real-time
Event stream → Kafka Topics → Stateful Stream Processing → Sink idempoten (Exactly-Once guarantee)
In-Memory Computing: Menghindari I/O disk berulang — 10–100x lebih cepat untuk kalkulasi iteratif.
Arsitektur Lambda (Batch + Speed layer) vs Kappa (Semua stream). Hindari Shuffle berlebih!
